The bijection was independently re-derived: 181 records entered a terminal folder since v0.6.9, 104 cited, 0 missing, 0 invented, 0 internal cited. Note on tier and manifestHash: this detector has no pinned manifest of its own, but checkReceiptGate applies the manifest-era checks per gate once the release-gate manifest exists in the content tree, so this receipt echoes the same hash and declares the same tier as the crosscheck. The manifest caveat recorded in the iss35 receipt applies to that hash here too. REVIEWED TREE VERSUS SHIPPED TREE. Both passes ran against b5df66c287497064a620bb4e58a546b846733009. This receipt names 4b4076a10f89d4d02da359274dad8994e30cae0e. The delta is four files and every one is a fix responding to these passes: the composer prompt_version bump 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 with its agents/CHANGELOG.md entry (dc-2, a CI blocker), two recomposed CHANGELOG lines (dc-1 record family, dc-3 five-state), and a fenced-code fix to iss-2609011217083577 that site-render refused. No unreviewed change rides along; `git diff b5df66c2 4b4076a1` is the check. No confirming pass was run against the final commit: that is the maintainer's recorded decision under verifier-selects-gates-decide, disclosed here rather than implied.
